readme.notesText: Amounts are in the original currency; VND uses each entry's own rate (the bank's actual VND where known). Currencies are never added together. A recorded expense isn't automatically deductible or VAT-claimable — see the CIT and Input VAT columns. Evidence paths point into this ZIP's evidence folder.
